scenario.topic: Decide which AI coding assistant the programming club should evaluate

options.name: GitHub Copilot
options.upside: Offers deep code completion and context-aware suggestions.
options.concern: Requires a paid subscription after trial period.

options.name: Tabnine

attrs.integration: Multiple IDEs including VS Code and IntelliJ

options.upside: Supports both cloud and local AI models for privacy options.
options.concern: Some advanced features require paid subscription.

options.name: Kite
options.upside: Provides line-of-code completions and documentation lookup.
options.concern: Limited language support compared to others.

options.name: Codeium
options.upside: No cost and supports multiple popular languages and IDEs.
options.concern: Newer tool with smaller user community.

shared_context: The programming club will evaluate one AI coding assistant to support members in various languages and projects. The chosen assistant should offer multi-language support, integration options, and be accessible for all club members.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a software engineer passionate about open-source tools and community-driven projects.
personas.private_goal: She wants a free, versatile AI assistant that supports multiple languages and IDEs without subscription fees.

A.reason_for: Offers deep code completion and context-aware suggestions, useful for complex projects.
A.reason_against: Requires paid subscription after trial, which conflicts with budget concerns.

B.reason_for: Supports cloud and local models offering privacy and flexibility.
B.reason_against: Some advanced features require payment, which could limit access.

C.reason_for: Free with optional paid features and decent language support.
C.reason_against: Limited language support compared to others may restrict some projects.

D.reason_for: Free, supports multiple popular languages and IDEs, meeting budget and accessibility needs.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a full-stack developer focused on maximizing productivity with cutting-edge tools.
personas.private_goal: He wants the most powerful AI assistant to accelerate coding and reduce errors, even if it costs money.

A.reason_for: Deep code completion and context-aware suggestions improve coding efficiency.

B.reason_for: Supports multiple IDEs and offers privacy options with local models.
B.reason_against: Advanced features behind paywall could limit full potential.

C.reason_for: Good for documentation lookup and line completions.
C.reason_against: Limited language support and less powerful than others.

D.reason_for: Free and supports popular languages and IDEs.
D.reason_against: Newer tool with smaller user base, possibly less mature features.

personas.name: Noah
personas.background: Noah is a computer science student who prefers simple, free tools that integrate easily with his workflow.
personas.private_goal: He wants an AI assistant that is easy to use and free, even if it supports fewer languages.

A.reason_for: Powerful and context-aware, good for advanced coding.
A.reason_against: Paid subscription is a barrier for a student budget.

B.reason_against: Paid tiers limit access to advanced features.

C.reason_for: Free with optional paid features and good integration with common editors.

D.reason_for: Free and supports multiple popular languages and IDEs.
D.reason_against: Newer tool with smaller community might affect support.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a backend developer who values powerful tools that integrate well with popular IDEs.
personas.private_goal: She wants an AI assistant that boosts productivity and supports multiple languages, even if it costs.

A.reason_for: Strong integration with VS Code and JetBrains IDEs and excellent code completion.

B.reason_for: Supports many IDEs and languages, with privacy options.
B.reason_against: Some features require payment, which could be restrictive.

C.reason_for: Good for documentation lookup and line completions.
C.reason_against: Limited language support and less powerful than others.

D.reason_for: Free and supports popular languages and IDEs.
D.reason_against: Newer and smaller user community may limit resources.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a pragmatic developer who prefers straightforward, no-cost solutions that work well out of the box.
personas.private_goal: He wants a free AI assistant that supports multiple languages and IDEs without complicated setups.

A.reason_against: Subscription cost is a dealbreaker for free access.

B.reason_for: Flexible integration and privacy with cloud and local models.
B.reason_against: Paid tiers limit access to full features.

C.reason_for: Free with optional paid features and decent language support.
C.reason_against: Limited language support compared to others.

D.reason_for: Completely free and supports multiple popular languages and IDEs, ideal for accessibility.
